Manila Water strengthens its fire preparedness this Fire Prevention Month with the maintenance and readiness check of over 3,300 fire hydrants across the East Zone. 🚒💧
 
This includes purple hydrants that use treated wastewater—helping conserve drinking water while giving firefighters an additional supply for emergencies.
 
Working closely with the Bureau of Fire Protection and LGUs, Manila Water ensures that hydrants are visible, accessible, and fully functional, especially in dense and vulnerable communities where quick water access can prevent major damage.
 
Hydrant upkeep remains a year‑round commitment as part of Manila Water’s dedication to public safety and reliable service across the East Zone.
 
Read more: https://t.co/PtrdN4x6us
 
Safety flows where readiness begins.
 
#StaySafeKatubig #SerbisyongKatubig #FirePreventionMonth

PATULOY ANG PAGTULONG NG DSWD SA MGA NASUNUGAN SA NIA ROAD 🤝

Binisita ni Sec @rex_gatchalian kasama si Quezon City Mayor @QCMayorJoy ang mga pamilyang naapektuhan ng malaking sunog sa NIA Road, Quezon City, para kumustahin ang kanilang kalagayan at pag-usapan ang pamamahagi ng Financial Assistance. ❤

Kasabay nito ang pamamahagi natin ng ilang mga pangunahing pangangailangan ng bawat pamilya sa evacuation center para tiyaking sila ay may gamit at sapat na makakain:

✅ Family Food Packs (FFPs)
✅ Family Kits
✅ Hygiene Kits
✅ Cooking Kits
✅ Sleeping Kits

Alinsunod ito sa utos ng Pangulo @bongbongmarcos, na siguraduhin dapat na walang pamilyang apektado ang magugutom at walang sapat na kagamitan. Kaya kahit saan, kahit kailan, handa ang DSWD tumugon sa ano mang unos. 🙌

#BawatBuhayMahalagaSaDSWD❤️ #DSWDServes #REXGatchalian #DSWD #DSWDPH #DSWDPhilippines #DisasterResponse #QuezonCity #FFPs #FinancialAssistance
